sourcePolicyConstruction: All 61 original sources participate independently of names, visibility or camera. CORE chooses complete original source volumes as conservative no-penetration obstacles; incomplete source sets become explicit two-sided zero-thickness geometric sheet barriers, with physical thickness and signed volume unavailable. No source is removed to improve fit. H6 topology only decides whether that chosen representation is mathematically eligible; it does not prove real material/solid semantics.
